item.title: Road buckling / heave - very dangerous, 3rd October
item.description:
No category for other road surface defects so reported under pothole. Significant road surface heave/buckling within the bus stop. The tarmac has risen into a pronounced ridge/wave running longitudinally along the carriageway. The heave has a depth of 6-7 inches and could cause a bike to have an accident, cars also have to avoid. Location: A21, Bromley Common, towards LocksBottom, just after junction with Southlands Road. Road surface in question is opposite bus stop. Https://w3w.co/scar.gloves.onions I have reported this previously and report marked as fixed but nothing done to remedy. Please repair road ASAP.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 77, Bromley Common, Bromley Common, Greater London
